decisions.reason: The existing Event adds the connector and increments the count, but the aggregate JST destination list must also include the new panel power button.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: The power board is no problem, so could you instead add a 2-pin JST-GH connector to the main board for a panel-mounted power button? PWRON already arrives through J\_PWR\_SIG pin 4; the new connector only needs to tap that line so a button can be wired from the enclosure panel.

decisions.reason: The new connector taps the existing PWRON interboard signal and does not assign or change an ESP32 GPIO.
Adding a panel-button connector on the PWRON line does not change current-monitor IC, rail coverage, placement, or channel usage.
The existing message-439 MODIFY already records relocation to the main board, the J_PWR_SIG pin 4 source, and the corresponding scope change.
The source decision does not alter the main board's local decoupling requirement.
The panel power-button connector does not change addressable-LED supply, switching, model, or data-level handling.
Tapping the PWRON control line does not change the power-source OR-ing topology or source-selection behavior.
The new panel connector does not change standalone USB activation, LDO capacity, or powered scope.
The decision adds a main-board panel connector and does not alter any sensor-board input or output connector.
The PWRON panel-button connection is independent of the CHGLED connector and charge-status indication.
The source decision concerns the PWRON line and has no effect on I2C series resistors or their topology.
Message 439 relocates the power-button connector but does not change the DCDC1 output setpoint; the voltage question remains separate.
